title: 交朋友
description: 認識新朋友與社交場合用語

sentences.en: I couldn't help but notice that you seem to share the same passion for photography that I've had since college.
sentences.zh: 我忍不住注意到你似乎和我一樣，從大學以來就對攝影有著同樣的熱情。

sentences.en: Would you mind if I joined your group, since I'm new here and don't really know anyone at this gathering?
sentences.zh: 你介意我加入你們嗎？因為我是新來的，在這個聚會上真的不認識任何人。

sentences.en: The person who introduced us at the conference last week mentioned that you're working on something quite fascinating.
sentences.zh: 上週在研討會上介紹我們認識的那個人提到你正在做一件很有趣的事。

sentences.en: Having just moved to this city, I've been looking for people who enjoy hiking on weekends and exploring new trails.
sentences.zh: 剛搬到這個城市，我一直在尋找週末喜歡健行和探索新步道的人。

sentences.en: It's always a pleasure to meet someone who appreciates good literature, especially the classics that most people overlook.
sentences.zh: 認識一個欣賞好文學的人總是令人愉快的，尤其是那些大多數人忽略的經典作品。

sentences.en: I've been meaning to ask whether you'd like to grab coffee sometime, since we always seem to run into each other.
sentences.zh: 我一直想問你是否願意找時間一起喝杯咖啡，因為我們似乎總是碰到彼此。

sentences.en: The book club that my neighbor recommended has turned out to be a wonderful way to meet like-minded individuals.
sentences.zh: 我鄰居推薦的讀書會，結果成了認識志同道合的人的好方式。

sentences.en: If you're not doing anything this Saturday, a few of us are planning to check out that new art exhibition downtown.
sentences.zh: 如果你這個星期六沒事的話，我們幾個人打算去看看市中心那個新的藝術展覽。

sentences.en: What I find most refreshing about meeting new people is discovering perspectives that challenge my own way of thinking.
sentences.zh: 我覺得認識新朋友最令人耳目一新的是發現能挑戰我自己思維方式的觀點。

sentences.en: Since we both seem to be regulars at this café, I figured it was about time we actually introduced ourselves properly.
sentences.zh: 既然我們似乎都是這家咖啡廳的常客，我想是時候我們正式自我介紹了。

sentences.en: The cooking class I signed up for, which starts next month, is supposed to be a great place to meet interesting people.
sentences.zh: 我報名的那個下個月開始的烹飪課，據說是認識有趣的人的好地方。

sentences.en: I really admire how effortlessly you seem to connect with everyone at these social events, which is something I'm still working on.
sentences.zh: 我真的很佩服你在這些社交場合似乎能毫不費力地與每個人建立聯繫，這是我仍在努力的事。

sentences.en: Would it be alright if I added you on social media, so we could stay in touch after this workshop ends?
sentences.zh: 我可以在社群媒體上加你嗎？這樣我們在這個工作坊結束後還能保持聯繫。

sentences.en: Growing up in a small town, I never realized how rewarding it could be to build friendships with people from diverse backgrounds.
sentences.zh: 在小鎮長大的我，從未意識到與來自不同背景的人建立友誼會是多麼有意義。

sentences.en: The mutual friend who connected us clearly has excellent taste, because I've genuinely enjoyed our conversation so far.
sentences.zh: 把我們聯繫在一起的共同朋友顯然很有眼光，因為到目前為止我真的很享受我們的對話。

sentences.en: I was wondering whether you might be interested in joining our weekend volleyball team, since we're looking for new members.
sentences.zh: 我在想你是否有興趣加入我們的週末排球隊，因為我們正在尋找新成員。

sentences.en: It takes a certain kind of courage to walk up to a stranger and start a conversation, which is exactly what I'm doing right now.
sentences.zh: 走向一個陌生人並開始對話需要一定的勇氣，而這正是我現在正在做的事。

sentences.en: The friendships that develop naturally over time, rather than being forced, tend to be the ones that truly last.
sentences.zh: 隨著時間自然發展而非被強迫的友誼，往往才是真正能持久的。

sentences.en: Having attended several networking events this year, I can honestly say that this one has been the most welcoming by far.
sentences.zh: 今年參加了幾場社交活動後，我可以誠實地說這一場是目前為止最熱情好客的。

sentences.en: If you ever need someone to practice your Spanish with, I'd be more than happy to be your conversation partner.
sentences.zh: 如果你需要有人陪你練習西班牙語，我非常樂意當你的對話夥伴。

sentences.en: The thing I appreciate most about our newly formed friendship is that we can be completely honest with each other.
sentences.zh: 我最欣賞我們新建立的友誼的一點是，我們可以彼此完全坦誠。

sentences.en: Before I moved here, someone told me that making friends as an adult would be difficult, but I've found quite the opposite.
sentences.zh: 在我搬來這裡之前，有人告訴我成年後交朋友會很困難，但我發現恰恰相反。

sentences.en: I noticed you were standing alone at the party, which reminded me of how I felt when I first started attending these events.
sentences.zh: 我注意到你在派對上獨自站著，這讓我想起了我第一次開始參加這些活動時的感覺。

sentences.en: The community garden project, which my colleague suggested I join, has introduced me to some of the kindest people I've ever met.
sentences.zh: 我同事建議我參加的社區花園計畫，讓我認識了一些我見過最善良的人。

sentences.en: What drew me to your group was the infectious laughter I could hear from across the room, and I wanted to be part of it.
sentences.zh: 吸引我到你們這群人的是我從房間另一邊就能聽到的有感染力的笑聲，我想成為其中一份子。

sentences.en: Since we'll be working in the same department starting next week, I thought it would be nice to get to know each other beforehand.
sentences.zh: 既然我們下週開始將在同一個部門工作，我覺得事先互相認識一下會很好。

sentences.en: The language exchange meetup that happens every Thursday evening has become my favorite way to make international friends.
sentences.zh: 每週四晚上的語言交換聚會已經成為我交國際朋友最喜歡的方式。

sentences.en: I hope I'm not being too forward, but I'd really love to continue this conversation over dinner sometime this week.
sentences.zh: 我希望我不會太唐突，但我真的很想在這週找個時間繼續在晚餐時聊這個話題。

sentences.en: Meeting people who share your values and sense of humor is one of life's greatest pleasures, and I think we have that connection.
sentences.zh: 遇到與你價值觀和幽默感相同的人是人生最大的樂趣之一，我覺得我們有那種連結。

sentences.en: Although I tend to be introverted by nature, I've learned that pushing myself to attend social gatherings always pays off in the end.
sentences.zh: 雖然我天性偏內向，但我已經學到強迫自己去參加社交聚會最終總是值得的。
